subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Leading Indicators
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Leading Indicators.

hook.text: Home Depot's sales spike when weather forecasts predict hurricanes—days before the storm hits.

buildup.text: Leading indicators are external signals that predict demand changes before they show up in sales data.

discovery.text: Weather, housing starts, consumer confidence, and web search trends can all signal future demand shifts.

twist.text: Not every correlation is a leading indicator. Testing the lead time and reliability of each signal is critical.

climax.text: Companies using leading indicators in forecasting improve accuracy by 10–20% for affected categories.

punchline.text: See the signal before the sale. That's the advantage.

quiz.question: What is a leading indicator?
options: An external signal that predicts demand before it appears
